assets.description: Classic Nike Swoosh logo in solid black. Ideal for placement in banner corners or as a header lockup. Works seamlessly on light or dark backgrounds with excellent contrast for all banner placements.

Nike Mind slider shoe in all-black with textured perforated details and responsive cushioning visible. Positioned side-angle on neutral background. Can rotate as hero product to showcase innovative footwear design.

Nike Mind women's slider in mint-green with contrasting white perforated sole and red interior cushioning visible. Clean three-quarter view on white background. Rotates as hero to highlight contemporary color innovation.

Female model wearing mauve ribbed cardigan and lavender shorts with white Nike socks and burgundy boots on neutral background. Full-body lifestyle shot perfect for hero placement showcasing coordinated new arrival apparel collection.

Female model in iridescent purple windbreaker and matching lavender tracksuit with white accents on clean white background. Full-body presentation ideal as rotating hero to highlight seasonal layering pieces and color coordination.

Female model in beige zip-up fleece hoodie with small white Nike Swoosh detail, captured in shoulder portrait on neutral background. Minimal, elegant styling suitable for sidebar or secondary product placement in banner layouts.

Female model in soft pink pullover hoodie with embroidered white Nike Swoosh on neutral background. Portrait-style shot emphasizing comfort and minimalist design. Works well as rotating hero or secondary product tile in apparel-focused campaigns.
